The error occurred because your interactive shell is **`fish`**, which does not use POSIX/Bash syntax (`VAR=val`, `if [ ... ]; then ... fi`, `for ... in ...; do ... done`). 

Here are the two ways to resolve it:

---

### Option 1: Run via `bash` (Quickest & Recommended)

Simply switch to `bash` or run the block inside `bash -c`:

```bash
bash -c '
cd /home/prem/Projects/AppleTV
mkdir -p .agents/raw_transcripts

# 1. Main session transcript
MAIN_BRAIN="/home/prem/.config/AntigravityManager/profiles/0a687723-2b9e-410c-849a-39cdb95fe290/home/.gemini/antigravity/brain/ffbf00b0-14b0-45fb-a910-ca3aa8b97a04/.system_generated/logs"
if [ -d "$MAIN_BRAIN" ]; then
    cp "$MAIN_BRAIN"/transcript*.jsonl .agents/raw_transcripts/main_session_
fi

# 2. Subagent brain folders
for brain_dir in /home/prem/.config/AntigravityManager/profiles/*/home/.gemini/antigravity/brain/*; do
    conv_id=$(basename "$brain_dir")
    log_dir="$brain_dir/.system_generated/logs"
    if [ -f "$log_dir/transcript.jsonl" ]; then
        cp "$log_dir/transcript.jsonl" ".agents/raw_transcripts/${conv_id}_transcript.jsonl"
    fi
    if [ -f "$log_dir/transcript_full.jsonl" ]; then
        cp "$log_dir/transcript_full.jsonl" ".agents/raw_transcripts/${conv_id}_transcript_full.jsonl"
    fi
done

# 3. Stage, commit, and push
git add .agents/raw_transcripts/
git commit -m "chore: archive distinct raw session transcripts for all subagents"
git push origin main
'
```

---

### Option 2: Native `fish` Syntax

If you prefer executing natively in `fish`:

```fish
cd /home/prem/Projects/AppleTV
mkdir -p .agents/raw_transcripts

# 1. Copy the current main session transcript
set MAIN_BRAIN "/home/prem/.config/AntigravityManager/profiles/0a687723-2b9e-410c-849a-39cdb95fe290/home/.gemini/antigravity/brain/ffbf00b0-14b0-45fb-a910-ca3aa8b97a04/.system_generated/logs"
if test -d "$MAIN_BRAIN"
    cp $MAIN_BRAIN/transcript*.jsonl .agents/raw_transcripts/main_session_
end

# 2. Iterate through all subagent brain folders
for brain_dir in /home/prem/.config/AntigravityManager/profiles/*/home/.gemini/antigravity/brain/*
    set conv_id (basename "$brain_dir")
    set log_dir "$brain_dir/.system_generated/logs"
    if test -f "$log_dir/transcript.jsonl"
        cp "$log_dir/transcript.jsonl" ".agents/raw_transcripts/"$conv_id"_transcript.jsonl"
    end
    if test -f "$log_dir/transcript_full.jsonl"
        cp "$log_dir/transcript_full.jsonl" ".agents/raw_transcripts/"$conv_id"_transcript_full.jsonl"
    end
end

# 3. Stage, commit, and push
git add .agents/raw_transcripts/
git commit -m "chore: archive distinct raw session transcripts for all subagents"
git push origin main
```
